name: 버섯 요정 숲
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly enchanted forest floor with oversized glowing mushrooms growing between thick gnarled tree roots, soft moss carpeting the ground beneath; three-quarter low composition, open lower-central foreground, cool teal bioluminescent mushroom glow mixed with warm amber light filtering through the canopy, damp bark texture, scattered leaves, layered woodland depth, whimsical fantasy concept art, faint spores drifting in the still air.
